verdicts.reason: A keeps the original reading order (logo → can → headline → CTA) cleanly centered; flaws: a large dead gap between the can and the headline, and the legal line is very small. B moves the GLACIER logo below the headline, which breaks the brand-first order, runs the oversized headline almost to the canvas edges, and wraps the legal text into two microscopic lines.

A puts the headline above the logo and over the edge of the teal circle; the CTA has shrunk and is weak; the legal text is left-aligned off the centered axis and tiny, and there is a large empty band above the CTA. B is a faithful centered reflow with clear hierarchy; its only issues are the gap above the headline and very small legal text.

A shrinks the hero SOLSTICE can to an illegible icon jammed beside a tiny CTA at the bottom, so the key imagery is lost. Its headline sits on the circle edge, the legal line floats mid-canvas above the CTA, and a huge empty void is left behind. B keeps the product, the logo and the hierarchy intact, and only needs polish to the gap spacing and the legal-text size.
